subject.title: Models: fully dynamic model discovery (OpenRouter + beyond)

question: Should dynamic model discovery be a core cross-provider catalog feature, provider-owned plugin/runtime behavior, or remain limited to documented configured-provider workarounds?
rationale: The issue asks for provider, config, cache, picker/list, and safety semantics that repository policy treats as maintainer product and compatibility decisions.

options.title: Design a provider catalog contract
options.body: Define and document a provider-owned dynamic catalog hook with explicit allowlist and cache semantics before implementing OpenRouter, OpenAI, and local-provider variants.

options.title: Limit to current seams
options.body: Keep current synthetic configured rows and plugin augmentation only, and document provider-specific workarounds until a clearer missing API appears.

options.title: Close as plugin-owned
options.body: Route dynamic discovery entirely to external plugins or ClawHub if maintainers decide core should not own this behavior.

recommendation.title: Design a provider catalog contract
recommendation.body: Define and document a provider-owned dynamic catalog hook with explicit allowlist and cache semantics before implementing OpenRouter, OpenAI, and local-provider variants.

likelyOwner.reason: joshp123 is the live assignee for this maintainer-labeled product-direction tracker.
